channel.title: Bryan County News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Bryan County News (bryancountynews.com)

item.title: Bryan County man reflects on near-death, business collapse, and the discipline that helped him start again
item.description: For most people in Bryan County, Donald R. Payseur is the face and driving force behind Coastal Broadband, Inc., but beyond his work in telecommunications, Payseur carries another calling: storytelling.

item.title: New Richmond Hill–Midway Alumni Chapter of Kappa Alpha Psi marks chartering with focus on youth, community service
item.description: The Richmond Hill–Midway (GA) Alumni Chapter of Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity, Inc. held its Public Chartering Celebration on Friday evening, February 27 at the Richmond Hill City Center, marking a historic milestone for the fraternity and the Coastal Empire community.

item.title: Bryan County girls' soccer facing uphill battle this season with depleted roster
item.description: No one told Kristen Barnhill coaching girls’ soccer at Bryan County was going to be easy. But after a school record three straight playoff appearances the fifth-year coach thought things would be going a little smoother.

item.title: Wildcats baseball look for "reset" after rocky period
item.description: At this point of the season, Richmond Hill is being again reminded how baseball can be a long season filled with peaks and valleys.

item.title: Belle Island Road home is Yard of the Month for March
item.description: The home of Terry & Susan Logan at 1594 Belle Island Road, has been selected by the Richmond Hill Garden Club for its Yard of the Month for March. The Logans have lived on Belle Island since 2008, having moved to Richmond Hill from Savannah in 1989.

item.title: Forum focuses on economic outlook and tax environment
item.description: The Development Authority of Bryan County (DABC) welcomed regional employers, industry partners, and community leaders on Wednesday, February 25, for its Q1 Employer’s Forum, held at the HL-GA Battery Company facility.

item.title: Bryan County girls end season with loss against Brooks County
item.description: The season did not end the way they wanted but there’s no overlooking the accomplishments of Bryan County’s senior girls' basketball players.

item.title: Michele Knight named CEO of Bryan County Chamber of Commerce
item.description: “Michele’s leadership style and vision align perfectly with where Bryan County is today — growing, evolving, and full of opportunity,” said Matt Hodges, Chair of the Bryan County Chamber of Commerce Board of Directors.

item.title: Wildcat basketball players earn region honors
item.description: Richmond Hill's boys’ and girls’ basketball teams both concluded their season earlier than expected, but some of their players did receive regional honors for their play.

item.title: Bryan County shows grit in narrow extra-inning win over Emanuel County Institute
item.description: Bryan County baseball coach Kyle Farmer likes to talk about his team playing with "grit and toughness". It’s all part of the culture he’s trying to establish in his second year with the Redskins.
